svg.title: Three 8-bit additions: 100 + 100 overflows with carry-out 0, -100 + -100 overflows with carry-out 1, 100 + -100 does not overflow but has carry-out 1
svg.text: Overflow = both operands share a sign and the sum has the other sign (test C), not the carry-out C7
Option A (C7 = 1) misses row 1 and falsely flags row 3. Option C flags exactly rows 1 and 2.
